Messages.Author: Henke
Messages.Body:
Hi,
If I have Revelations in play, how are the various effects of these vampires
specialitys handled?

Darius Styx [DS]
<Independent>. As a (D) action, Darius may pick one card at random from
{another} Methuselah's hand. If it is an equipment or retainer card, place
it on Darius at no cost [(using the inferior version, if it requires a
skill)]; otherwise, return it to the Methuselah's hand.

Imogen [Sabbat]
Sabbat Archbishop of Miami: As a +1 stealth (D) action, Imogen may pick one
card at random from the hand of her prey or predator and exchange it with
any card in that Methuselah's ash heap

Kendrick [Sabbat]
Sabbat Priscus: If Kendrick is ready during your master phase, you may look
at a card at random from your prey's hand. If that card is a political
action, your prey discards it.

Can they now pick exactly the card they want, is the prey's hand turned over
and randomized when they pick the card? Is Kendricks abilty any differnt as
it says 'look' instead of 'pick'?
Another thing: Is the prey allowed to indicate which card the vampire should
choose? Could be useful for instance if Darius desperatly needs something to
tame the deck that threatens to sweep te table...

/henke

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Henke wrote:
>
> Hi,
> If I have Revelations in play, how are the various effects of these vampires
> specialitys handled?

The same as before. Revelations says nothing about changing the randomness
of these effects.

> Darius Styx [DS]
> <Independent>. [...] pick one card at random [...].
>
> Imogen [Sabbat]
> Sabbat Archbishop of Miami: [...] pick one card at random [...]
>
> Kendrick [Sabbat]
> Sabbat Priscus: [..] card picked at random [...]

>
> Can they now pick exactly the card they want, is the prey's hand turned over
> and randomized when they pick the card? Is Kendricks abilty any differnt as
> it says 'look' instead of 'pick'?

The random card is still chosen randomly. If you need to have the player
picker her hand up and shuffle those cards in order to do that, fine.
A seven-sided die would also work (assuming the standard hand size), etc.

> Another thing: Is the prey allowed to indicate which card the vampire should
> choose? Could be useful for instance if Darius desperatly needs something to
> tame the deck that threatens to sweep te table...

Moot, since the random selection is still random.
